§bRockbloom Seeds§r

Space rock seeds, T0 to T10, that drop that tier's planet stones. Terran Rockbloom comes from crossing Stone Lily with another stone lily; T1-T4 cross the previous one with Reactoria, T5-T10 with Stargatium. Each needs Artificial Soil of its tier or better.

§cRebalanced§r: about 1 block per harvest, plus 1 for every 2 seed bed tiers above the Rockbloom's.

§aTask§r: tick the box once you've read this.
